answer: Each agent leases one vine-tending work slot for a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it files a thread of vine readings in a mirror ledger. An auditor recomputes growth; a reading over 3% off or a second thread from one key forfeits the bond. First filing 33, the k-th 33+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,030,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-vine ring pays the rising fee. An honest keeper pays 33 once; the mirror ledger returns the bond after a clean epoch.
